verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll's own marketing says employers can access 401(k) plans and manage them from the payroll account, and it calculates deductions from each paycheck. It does not explicitly document that retirement contributions sync automatically with every payroll run, and the asterisks on the benefits claim suggest add-on or partner terms. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic per-payroll 401(k) contribution sync, details of the plan provider and integration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can offer a 401(k) or retirement plan whose contributions sync automatically with each payroll

citations.quote: Access HR** and team benefits—including healthcare,** 401(k) plans,** and workers’ comp**—and manage everything from your payroll account.
Set up and calculate garnishments and deductions from each paycheck.
